title: יְבַל
content:
[Str2987,2986] † [יְבַל] vb. Haph. bear along, carry (v. BH);—Pf. 3 ms. הֵיבֵל, acc. rei + ל loc. Ezr 5:14, 6:5; Inf. לְהֵיבָלָה 7:15, acc. rei.

[Str3007,3006] † [יבֶּ֫שֶׁת] n.f. earth (so Syr.; Targum as BH יַבָּשָׁה dry land, √ יָבֵשׁ);—emph. יַבֶּשְׁתָּא Dn 2:10.

[Str3026] † [יְגַּר] n.[m.] (stone-)heap (Targum id.; Syr. ወገረ፡; cf. Eth. ወግረ፡ throw together, ወግር፡ mound);—cstr. שָֽהֲדוּתָא ´י: Gn 31:47 (= Heb. גַּל־עֵד).

[Str3027–28] † יַד n.f.:Dn 5:5 hand (v. BH);—cstr. ´י: Ezr 5:12 + ; emph. יְדָא Dn 5:5, 5:24; sf. יְדִי 3:15, יְדָךְ v:17, יְדֵהּEzr 6:12, יֶדְהֹם (K§ 53. 2. a)) 5:8, etc.; du. abs. בִּידַ֫יִן Dn 2:34, 2:45;—1. hand of man Dn 2:34, 2:45, Ezr 5:8, 6:12, and (in vision) Dn 5:5, 5:5, 5:24; fig. בִּידָח in thy possession Ezr 7:14, 7:25; fig. of God 4:32. 2. power, of man Dn 2:38, 3:15, 3:17, 7:28, Ezr 5:12, of God Dn 5:23; of lion 6:28 (al. paw).

title: יְדָא
content: [Str3029,3034]1095 † [יְדָא] vb.Haph. praise (v. BH ידךְ);—Pt. act. מְהוֺדֵא Dn 2:23 (ל dei), מוֺדֵא (K§§ 93, 2; 43, 1 c)) 6:11 (קְָדָם dei).

title: יְדַל
content:
[Str3045–46] † יְדַל vb. know (v. BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´י: Dn 5:21, 6:11, 2 ms. יְדַ֫עָתָּ 5:22, 1 s. יִדְעֵת 4:6; Impf. 2 ms. תִּנְדַּע (K§ 11, 4. b) β)) Ezr 4:15 +, etc.; Imu. דַּע ms. (K§ 11. 3 a)) Dn 6:16; Pt. act. יָדַע 2:8 + ; pl. יָֽדְעִין 5:23, etc.; pass. יְדיעַ 4:12 +;—know, c. acc. rei Dn 2:30, 5:22, acc. rei om. Ezr 7:25; ´יֽדְעֵי דָּתֵי א:, v:25, יָֽדְעֵי בִינָה Dn 2:21; c. obj. cl. v:8, v:9, v:22, 4:6, 4:14, 4:23, 4:29, 5:21, 6:11, 6:16, Ezr 4:15, so (of God) Dn 4:22; pt. act. abs. 5:23 having capacity of knowledge; pass. in periphr. conjug., subj. cl. + ל Pers. 3:18, Ezr 4:12, 4:13, 5:8. Haph. Pf. 3 ms. הוֺדַע Dn 2:15 +, sf. הוֺדְעָךְ v:29, 2 ms. sf. הוֺדַעְתַּ֫נִי v:23, תֶָּנָה- v:23 1 pl. הוֺדַ֫עְנָא Ezr 4:14; Impf. 3 ms. יְהוֺדַע Dn 2:25, sf. יְהוֺדְעִַ+נּנִי 7:16, etc. (v. K § 43 c)); Inf. לְהוֺדָעָה 5:8, sf. לְהוֺדָעֻתַ֫נִי 4:15, 5:16, etc.; Pt. act. pl. מְהוֺדְעִין 4:4 +;—cause to know, inform : ל Pers. Ezr 4:14, + acc. rei Dn 2:15, 2:17, 2:25, 2:30, 4:4, 5:8, 5:17, so (sf, Pers.) 2:5, 2:9, 2:26, 4:3, 4:15, 5:15, 5:16, 7:16, and (subj. God) 2:23; ל Pers. + obj. cl. Ezr 4:16, 7:24, so (of God) Dn 2:28, 2:29, 2:45, and (sf. Pers.) v:23; acc. Pers. only Ezr 5:10, 7:25.

[Str4486,4093] † מַנְדַּע n.[m.] knowledge, power of knowing (TargumJ id.; Syr. ܡܕܥܐ, ܡܘܕܥܐ; BH מַדָּע (late); cf. ‘Maṅdâ’ = γνῶσις, NöM xx);—abs. Dn 5:12; emph. דְּעָא- 2:21; sf. דְּעִי- 4:31, 4:33.

title: יְהַב
content:
[Str3051–52] † יְהַב vb. give (Targum Syr.; cf. BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´י: Ezr 5:12 +; 2 ms. יְהַבְתְּ Dn 2:23; 3 mpl. וִיהַ֫בוּ 3:28; Imv. ms. הַב (K§ 11. 3. a)) 5:17; Pt. act. יָהֵב 2:21, pl. יָֽהֲבִין 6:3;—1. give, acc. rei + ל Pers. Dn 2:48, 5:17, also (subj. God) 2:21, 2:23, 2:37, 2:38, 5:18, 5:19; give report 6:3 (ל Pers.) ; give over, acc. Pers. + בְּיַד (יַד 2.) Ezr 5:12 (subj. God); give up, surrender Dn 3:28 (one’s body, acc.). 2. place, lay foundations Ezr 5:16 (Nab. also place Cooke102, 1. 6 SACJQ 1904, 274; v. ܝܗܒ 2. SchulthLex; and ZAW xxii (1902), 162; cf. DWB 171). Pe‘îl (WCG 224), be given, subj. rei, c. ל Pers.:3 ms. יְהִיב Dn7:4, 7:6, יְהִב v:14, v:22, 3 fs. יְהִיבַת 5:28, 7:12, 7:27; 3 mpl. וִיהִ֫יבוּ Ezr 5:14; be given up (ל of flame) Dn 7:11. Hithpe. Impf. 3 ms. יִתְיְהֵב Dn 4:13, 3 fs. תִּתְיְהָב Ezr 6:4; 3 mpl. יִתְיַהֲבוּן Dn 7:25; Pt. מִתְיְהֵב Ezr 4:20, 6:9, fs. מִתְיִהֲבָא v:8, pl. בין- 7:19;—1. be given, subj. rei, ל Pers. Dn 4:13, Ezr 6:9, 7:19; be given over, subj. Pers. בִּידֵהּ (יַד 2. ) Dn 7:25. 2. be paid, of cost Ezr 6:4 (מִן of source), v:8 (ל Pers.), toll 4:20 (ל Pers.).

[Str3061,3063] † יְהוּד n.pr.terr. Judah (secondary format. from foll. acc. to M§ 68. b Buhl; cf. BH יְהוּדָה);—Dn 5:13 b, Ezr 5:1, 5:8, 7:14; ´בְּנֵי גָּלוּתָא דַּי י: Dn 2:25, 5:13 a, 6:14.

[Str3062,3064] † [יְהוּדַי] n.gent. Jew (BH יְהוּדִי);—pl. abs. יְהוּדָאִין (K§ 61, 6)) Dn 3:12; emph. יְהוּדָיֵא (Ib.:ib.) v:8, Ezr 4:12, 4:23, 5:1, 5:5, 6:7, 6:7, 6:8, 6:14.

[Str3117–18] † n.m.:Ezr 6:15 day (v. BH);—abs. ´י: Ezr 6:9, 6:9, 6:15, emph. יוֺמָא Dn 6:11, 6:14; pl. abs. יוֺמִין v:8 +, emph. יוֺמַיָּא 2:28 +; cstr. יוֺמֵי 5:11, and יוֺמָת (K § 51, 2, Anm. 3) Ezr 4:15, 4:19; sf. יוֺמֵיהוֺן Dn 2:44;—day, as division of time Dn 6:11, 6:14, day of month Ezr 6:15; thirty days Dn 6:8, 6:13; יוֺם בְּיוֺם Ezr 6:9 day by day; pl. esp. of duration: ´עַתִּיק י: one aged of days, aged man Dn 7:9, 7:13, 7:22; עָֽלְמָא ´י: days of old Ezr 4:15, 4:19: of a period: life-time, or reign, of king Dn 2:44, 5:11; ´לִקְצָת י: 4:31 at the end of the days (appointed time), ´בְּאַחֲרִית י: 2:28 in the latter part of the (future) days.

[Str3136] † יוֺצָדָק n.pr.m. Ezr 5:2 (BH id., √ הָיָה).

[Str7804] יזב v. שֵׁיוֵב. p. 1115

title: יחם
content: [Str2534,3179] יחם (√ of foll.; v. BH יָחַם, whence חֵמָה).

title: יְטַב
content: [Str3191] † [יְטַב] vb. be (good,) pleasing (Targum; Eg. Aram. Haf. הוטב S-CB11+; v. BH יטב);—Pe. Impf. יֵיטַב (K§ 43, 2) Ezr 7:18 (עַל Pers., + inf.).

title: יְכִל
content:
[Str3202,3201] † יְכִל (K§ 25, a) β)) vb. be able (Dn) (Targum; Nab. (rare) SAC60; Eg. Aram. S-CE 8, 11+; Chr-Pal. Schulth83; BH יָכֹל);—Pe. 1. c. Inf. be able to do:Pf. 3 ms. יְכִל Dn 6:21 (subj. God), 2 ms. יְכֵ֫לְתָּ 2:47; Impf. 3 ms. יוּכַל (Hebraism, K§ 43, 1. Beisp. b)) v:10, יִכֻּל 3:29 (subj. a god), 2 ms. תוכל 5:16, 5:16 (<both Qr תִּכּוּל, K1. c.); Pt. יָכִל 3:17, 4:34 (both subj. God); pl. יָֽכְּ לִין 2:27, 4:15, 6:5. 2. prevail (BH 2.) against (ל), Pt. fs. יָֽכְלָה 7:21.

[Str3220–21] † [יַם] n.m. sea (Targum Syr.; v.B יָם, √ ימם);—emph. יַמָּא Dn 7:2, 7:3.

title: יְסַף
content: [Str3254–55] † [יְסַף] vb add (v. BH);—Hoph. (WGG 225) Pf. 3 fs. הוּסֲפַת (K§§ 15 d): 17, 1; 43, 1, Beisp. c)) Dn 4:33 was added, ל Pers.

title: יְעַט
content: [Str3272,3289] † [יְעַט] vb. advise (so JAram.; BH יעץ);—Ithpa. Pf. 3 mpl. אִתְיָעַ֫טוּ (K§§ 23, 1. Anm.; 39, 5 ) Dn 6:8 recipr. took counsel with each other, sq . inf.

title: יָעֵט
content:
[Str3272] † [יָעֵט] n.m. counsellor (prop. Pt. act.);—pl. sf. יָֽעֲטֹ֫הִי Ezr 7:14, יָעֲט֫וֺהִי v:15.

[Str2942,5843] † עֵטָא n.f. counsel;—abs. Dn 2:14 (v. טְעֵם 2.). p. 1094

[Str3319] יצא v. שֵׁיצֵא. p. 1115

title: יְצַב
content:
[Str3321] † [יְצַב] vb. Pa. make certain, gain certainty (Targum; cf. BH);—Pa. Inf. לְיַצָּבָא Dn 7:19, c. עַל concerning.

[Str3330] † יַצִיב adj. certain, true (Targum id., firm, native (= אֶוְרָת));—abs. ´י: Dn 2:8, 2:45, emph. בָא- 3:24(K§ 59.g); fs. בָא- 6:13, 7:16;—1. certain, sure Dn 2:45; in exclam. 3:24 undoubtedly! מִן־יַצִּיב v:8 of a surety. 2. true 6:13; f. as subst. 7:16 the truth concerning, עַל rei.

title: יְקַד
content:
[Str3344–45] † [יְקַד] vb. burn (v.BH);—Pe. Pt. act. f. יָקִדְ תָּא Dn 3:6, 3:11, 3:15, 3:17, 3:20, 3:21, 3:23, 3:26.

[Str3346] † [יְקֵדָה] n.f. burning ;—cstr. לִיקֵדַת אָשָּׁה Dn 7:11.

title: יְקָר
content:
[Str3366–67] † [יְקָר] n.m.:Dn 2:6 honour (v. BH);—abs. וִיקָר) Dn 2:6, 7:14; cstr. id. 4:27, לִיקַר v:33 (K § 57. Anm. Str קָר-); emph. וִיקָרָא 2:37, 5:18, הָ֯ v:20.

[Str3358,3515] † [יַקִּיר] adj. honourable, difficult;—1. honourable, emph. יַקִּירָא Ezr 4:10. 2. difficult(cf. BH כָּבֵד adj. 1 d), fs. יַקִּירָה Dn 2:11.

[Str3390,3389] יְרוּשְׁלֵם:25 n.pr.loc. Jerusalem (BH יְרוּשָׁלִַם);—Dn 5:2, 5:3, 6:11, Ezr 4:8, 4:12 + 20 t. Ezr.

[Str3391,3393] † [יְרַךְ] n.m. month (v. BH);—abs. לִירַח אֲדָר Ezr 6:15; pl. abs. יַרְחִין Dn 4:26.

[Str3410,3409] † [יַרְכָה] n.f. thigh, or loin (Targum; v. BH ירך);—pl. sf. יַרְכָתֵהּ Dn 2:32.

[Str3478–79] † יִשְרָאֵל n.pr.gent. Israel (BH id., √ I. שָרָה);—´אֱלַהּ יִשׁ: Ezr 5:1, 6:14, 7:15; ´מֶלֶךְ לְיִש: 5:11; ´בְּנֵי יִש: 6:16, ´עַמָּא יִש: 7:13.

title: יֵשׁוּעַ
content: [Str3442–43] † יֵשׁוּעַ n.pr.m. (BH id., 3, p. 221);—Ezr 5:2.

title: ישׁן
content:
[Str3462,8142] ישׁן (√ of following; BH ישׁן, שֵנָה).

[Str8139,8140] † I. [שְׁנָה] n.f. sleep (Targum Syr.);—sf. שִׁנְּתֵהּ (K§ 12 d)) Dn 6:19.—II. [ שְׁנָה] v. [שְׁנָא]. p. 1116

title: יָת
content: [Str853,3487] † יָת mark of accus. (= BH I. אֵת; Palm. ית; Zinj.:Had. 28 c. sf. ותה; Nab. Palm. c. sf. יתה (Lzb263 Cooke170; cf. REvS468); Targum Sam. יָת; Syr. ܝܬ (rare); v. further p. 84 b);—Dn 3:12 דִּי מַנִּיתָ יָֽתְהוֺן whom thou hast appointed.

title: יְתִב
content:
[Str3488,3427] † יְתִב (K§ 25 a) β)) vb. sit, dwell (Targum Syr.; v. BH ישׁב);—Pe. 1. sit, be seatedPf. 3 ms. יְתִב Dn 7:9 and (of judgment = the judge) v:10, so Impf. 3 ms. יִתִָּב (K§ 43.1.Beisp. b), cf. BH יֵשֵׁב) 7:26. 2. dwell, Pt. pl. abs. יָתְבִין Ezr 4:17 (ב loc.). Haph. cause to dwell: Pf. 3 ms. הוֺתֵב 4:10 (acc. + ב loc.).

[Str3493,3498] † יַתִּיר adj. pre-eminent, surpassing (v. BH יתר);—ms. abs. ´י: Dn 2:31; fs. יַתִּירָא 6:4, usu. הָ֯ 4:33, 5:12, 5:14; as adv. exceedingly 3:22, 7:7, 7:19 (cf. יתיר מתבריך EutSin. 498 wh. Lzb401 reads יתירית בריך).
